subject: {first_name}, tip: scan one chart before opinions pile up
body_paragraphs: You installed Predictify Crypto but haven't scanned yet. Tip: don't start in Telegram. Open Command, upload one chart you actually trade, and leave with a written entry / stop / targets.
That first scan is the whole product — noise out, process in.
P.S. Not financial advice. One clean setup beats a weekend of doomscrolling.
